questions.stemHtml: A mother bring her new born baby with complaints of some breathing difficulties. On examination the baby had a difficulty in breathing along with scooped abdomen. On further investigations, an X ray revealed the presence of congenital diaphragmatic hernia and is given below. Which of the following is true regarding the most common type of congenital diaphragmatic hernia?

options.label: A
options.text: The most common type of it is bochdalek hernia.

options.label: B
options.text: Failure of normal closure of the pleuroperitoneal membrane.
